payload.text:
> I read this as auditing the Rust backend of the Tauri terminal app for invariant preservation, uncommitted diff safety, event emission completeness, and test coverage - launch parallel inspections across src-tauri and audit documentation.

<analysis>
**Literal Request**: Audit the Rust backend in `src-tauri/**` (including uncommitted changes in `ipc/terminal.rs` and `lib.rs`), verify invariants from prior audit/fix execution docs, check event emissions, uncover misimplementations/leaks/races/traversals/panics, and assess test suite validity.
**Actual Need**: Provide a rigorous, evidence-backed code audit covering all 5 requested dimensions with concrete file:line citations, severity levels, classifications, and exact findings on the current working tree state.
**Success Looks Like**: A comprehensive, structured audit report detailing all invariant checks, diff analysis, event audit, bugs/misimplementations, and test realism with absolute paths and exact line references.
</analysis>

<results>
<files>
- /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/worktree/manager.rs - Core worktree manager implementing 1-Writer-1-Worktree leases (`WriterLeaseRegistry`, `WriterLeaseGuard`), delete barriers (`delete_lock`, `remove_worktree_locked`), dirty checks, and canonical path containment.
- /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/terminal/pty.rs - PTY manager handling portable-pty lifecycle, session spawning with worktree writer leases, natural exit lifecycle polling, reader task timeouts, and child process reaping.
- /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/terminal/session.rs - Session representation holding PTY master/writer, child process handle, RAII lease guard, process group signaling (`libc::kill(-pid)`), and atomic state tracking.
- /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/ipc/terminal.rs - Uncommitted terminal IPC commands (`cmd_terminal_spawn`, `write`, `resize`, `signal`, `close`, `list`), lifecycle event polling/emission, and base64 output streaming.
- /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/lib.rs - Uncommitted application bootstrap, state management, desktop menu setup (`CmdOrCtrl+T`), and registration of all 42 Tauri command handlers.
- /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/ipc/worktree.rs - Worktree IPC handlers with `worktree_changed` event emissions (`Created`, `Deleted`, `DestructivelyDeleted`, `DirtyChanged`, `Pruned`) and `run_blocking` git offloading.
- /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/remote/tailscale.rs - Tailscale CLI inspection and command execution runner.
- /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/remote/server.rs - Axum HTTP/WebSocket gateway for remote terminal attachment and worktree operations.
- /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json - Tauri v2 application configuration, window specs, and CSP.

- /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/tests/backend_hardening.rs - Hardening tests covering path traversal, symlink escapes, dash namespaces, and camelCase serialization.
- /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/tests/ipc_hardening_contract.rs - IPC integration tests pinning event emissions, dirty transitions, and structured error payloads.
- /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/tests/e2e_agent_workflow.rs - End-to-end agent test pinning worktree creation, PTY script execution, dirty delete block, and destructive deletion.
</files>

<answer>
### 1. Invariant Verification

#### 1.1 1-Writer-1-Worktree Lease Invariant
- **Evidence**: `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/worktree/manager.rs:18-50, 60-84, 219-247`, `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/terminal/pty.rs:56-82`.
- **Status**: **VERIFIED & INTACT**.
- **Mechanics**:
  - `WriterLeaseRegistry` tracks active writer session IDs keyed by canonical worktree paths.
  - `acquire_writer_lease` returns a `WriterLeaseGuard` holding an RAII `Drop` implementation that automatically executes `release_canonical` when dropped.
  - `PtyManager::spawn_in_worktree` acquires the lease before spawning the PTY child; if spawning fails, the lease guard drops and immediately rolls back the reservation (pinned in `tests/worktree_safety.rs:114`).
  - Stale lease reclamation: if an existing writer session is no longer alive in `PtyManager`, `spawn_in_worktree` safely reclaims the lease (`src/terminal/pty.rs:64-73`).
  - Delete operations hold `delete_lock: Arc<Mutex<()>>` and explicitly execute `ensure_no_writer` before performing any git actions, preventing race conditions between writer acquisition and worktree deletion.

#### 1.2 PTY Spawn/Close Lifecycle & Zombie Prevention
- **Evidence**: `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/terminal/pty.rs:136-224, 261-330`, `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/terminal/session.rs:163-228`.
- **Status**: **VERIFIED & INTACT**.
- **Mechanics**:
  - Background `start_lifecycle_watcher` polls `child.try_wait()` every 20ms. On natural exit, it invokes `finalize_natural_exit` which closes I/O, joins the reader thread with a bounded 2s timeout (`join_reader_bounded`), drops writer leases, marks state as `Exited { code }`, closes the broadcast output channel, and unregisters the session.
  - Explicit close (`close_session`) sends `SIGTERM` (with fallback to `kill()`), shuts down I/O, bounds the reader thread join, and spawns `spawn_blocking` to execute `child.wait()` to reap the process handle and eliminate zombies.
  - Unix process group signaling: `TerminalSignal::Interrupt` sends VINTR (`0x03`) through the PTY line discipline to target the foreground process group (`src/terminal/session.rs:141-144`), while `Terminate`/`Kill` signals `-pid` (`libc::kill(-(pid as i32), sig)` at `src/terminal/session.rs:158`).

#### 1.3 Destructive Delete Guard Chain
- **Evidence**: `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/worktree/manager.rs:326-407`, `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/ipc/worktree.rs:118-181`.
- **Status**: **VERIFIED & INTACT**.
- **Mechanics**:
  - Safe delete (`cmd_worktree_delete`): `ensure_no_writer` -> `branch_deletion_preview` (returns `WorktreeError::UnmergedBranch` if branch is unmerged) -> `remove_worktree_locked` (returns `WorktreeError::DirtyWorktree` if untracked/modified files exist) -> `git worktree remove` -> `git worktree prune` -> `git branch -d`.
  - Destructive delete (`cmd_worktree_delete_destructive`): Bypasses the unmerged branch check and executes `git branch -D`, but **strictly maintains the dirty worktree check** (`remove_worktree_locked` always verifies `!dirty_state.is_dirty`). Untracked/dirty files are never deleted silently.
  - Error mappings: `UnmergedBranch` maps to `IpcErrorCode::UnmergedBranch` (`UNMERGED_BRANCH`), `DirtyWorktree` maps to `IpcErrorCode::DirtyWorktree` (`DIRTY_WORKTREE`).

---

### 2. Audit of Uncommitted Working Tree Diff

#### 2.1 Changes in `src-tauri/src/ipc/terminal.rs`
- **What Changed**:
  - Full implementation of `cmd_terminal_spawn`, `cmd_terminal_write`, `cmd_terminal_resize`, `cmd_terminal_signal`, `cmd_terminal_close`, and `cmd_terminal_list`.
  - Added background output forwarder pumping `broadcast_rx` to Tauri event `terminal_output` (base64 encoded).
  - Added post-stream exit poll loop (100 iterations x 20ms = 2s) to emit `terminal_lifecycle` (`Exited` or `Failed`).
- **Contract & Protocol Safety**:
  - `SpawnTerminalRequest` uses `#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase", deny_unknown_fields)]`.
  - Output chunks are base64-encoded to prevent non-UTF8 binary stream truncation.
  - Error responses cleanly map `PtyError` and `WorktreeError` to structured `IpcError`.
- **Race Conditions / Bugs**:
  - No race on session registration or lifecycle emission; `app.emit(TERMINAL_LIFECYCLE_EVENT, started)` failures trigger immediate session rollback (`src/ipc/terminal.rs:115-120`).

#### 2.2 Changes in `src-tauri/src/lib.rs`
- **What Changed**:
  - Extended modules: `pub mod daemon; pub mod browser; pub mod notification; pub mod remote; pub mod session;`.
  - Desktop application menu registered with `CmdOrCtrl+T` shortcut emitting `menu_new_terminal_tab` (`src/lib.rs:20-40`).
  - Added state management for `remote_manager`, `notification_audio`, and `browser_manager`.
  - Registered 42 Tauri command handlers across terminal, project, worktree, remote, notification, session, and browser modules.
- **Contract & Protocol Safety**:
  - All commands follow camelCase naming and structured error conventions.

---

### 3. Event Emission Audit

- **`worktree_changed` Event**:
  - `Created`: Emitted on successful worktree creation (`src/ipc/worktree.rs:110-115`).
  - `Deleted`: Emitted on safe worktree deletion (`src/ipc/worktree.rs:149-156`).
  - `DestructivelyDeleted`: Emitted on destructive deletion (`src/ipc/worktree.rs:150-156`).
  - `DirtyChanged`: Emitted during `cmd_worktree_status` when the dirty state transitions (`clean -> dirty` or `dirty -> clean`) based on cached snapshot tracking (`src/ipc/worktree.rs:219-226`).
  - `Pruned`: Emitted during worktree deletion when `git worktree prune` completes (`src/ipc/worktree.rs:158-164`).
  - *By-Design Gap*: `lock` and `branchChanged` variants are not emitted because the corresponding mutation IPC commands (`cmd_worktree_lock`, `cmd_worktree_rename_branch`) are not part of the backend surface.
- **`terminal_output` Event**:
  - Emits `{ sessionId, data: base64 }` for every chunk received from the PTY reader (`src/ipc/terminal.rs:125-132`).
- **`terminal_lifecycle` Event**:
  - Emits `{ sessionId, state: "started" }` upon spawn (`src/ipc/terminal.rs:108-114`).
  - Emits `{ sessionId, state: "exited" | "failed", exitCode, reason }` when the stream closes and child exit status is determined (`src/ipc/terminal.rs:147-167`).

---

### 4. Findings & Misimplementations

#### Finding 1: Synchronous Subprocess & Socket Calls in Async Handlers
- **File & Line**: `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/ipc/remote.rs:64, 157`, `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/remote/server.rs:188, 218`
- **Severity**: **Minor**
- **Classification**: **Bug**
- **Evidence**:
  - `cmd_remote_status` and `cmd_tailscale_status` invoke `check_tailscale_status(&SystemCommandRunner)` directly within an `async fn`. This runs `Command::new("tailscale").output()` synchronously on the Tokio runtime thread without wrapping in `tokio::task::spawn_blocking` or `run_blocking`.
  - In `remote/server.rs:188, 218`, Axum route handlers for `create_worktree` and `delete_worktree` call synchronous `mgr.create_worktree(...)` and `mgr.delete_worktree_and_branch(...)` (which execute synchronous `git` commands) directly on the worker thread.
- **Impact**: Heavy git operations or slow CLI queries on the remote server can momentarily starve the Tokio worker thread pool.

#### Finding 2: Unchecked `.unwrap()` on `serde_json::to_string` in Daemon Protocols
- **File & Line**: `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/daemon/client.rs:59, 79`, `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/daemon/server.rs:254, 302, 346, 360, 372`
- **Severity**: **Note**
- **Classification**: **Note**
- **Evidence**:
  - `daemon/client.rs:59` has `let mut json = serde_json::to_string(&handshake).unwrap();`.
  - `daemon/server.rs:254` has `let mut resp_json = serde_json::to_string(&resp).unwrap();`.
- **Impact**: `DaemonRequest` and `DaemonResponse` contain only serializable strings, integers, booleans, and vectors; serialization cannot fail in practice, but explicit error handling (`.map_err(...)`) is preferred.

#### Finding 3: Path Traversal & Security Validation
- **File & Line**: `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/src/worktree/manager.rs:141-217`
- **Severity**: **Note**
- **Classification**: **Note**
- **Evidence**:
  - Slug resolution in `worktree_path_for` validates ref syntax (`format_branch_name`), bans `..`, `//`, `@{`, leading dashes, and control characters, verifies path prefix containment (`ensure_canonical_inside_root`), and checks ancestor canonicalization.
  - Tauri configuration `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/src-tauri/capabilities/default.json:5-7` restricts permissions specifically to webview `"main"`. Sub-webviews created for browser panels do not receive Tauri guest API capabilities.

---

### 5. Honest Review of Test Suite Coverage (`src-tauri/tests/*`)

| Test Area | What is Solidly Pinned (Real) | What is Mocked / Limited |
|---|---|---|
| **1-Writer-1-Worktree & Deletion Barriers** (`tests/worktree_safety.rs`) | Real Git repositories (`tempfile::TempDir`), actual branch checkouts, real lease rejections, `WriterAlreadyActive` errors, dirty uncommitted file delete refusal, and PTY lease rollback on spawn failure. | Tests are local-filesystem based (sufficient for POSIX git behavior). |
| **Backend & IPC Hardening** (`tests/backend_hardening.rs`, `tests/ipc_hardening_contract.rs`) | `..` path traversal, symlink escapes, dash prefix branches, camelCase serialization, `deny_unknown_fields` reject checks, and `DirtyChanged`/`Pruned` event sequences. | Uses `tauri::test::mock_builder()`, which tests in-memory Rust Tauri event routing rather than a real WebKit/WebView renderer process. |
| **End-to-End Agent Workflow** (`tests/e2e_agent_workflow.rs`) | Real Git init/commit, worktree creation, real PTY spawn (`portable-pty`), input command execution, completion marker output capture, dirty check, and destructive deletion. | Verifies full backend integration without browser rendering. |
| **Session Persistence** (`tests/session_persistence_integration.rs`, `tests/daemon_persistence_contract.rs`) | Atomic write via `.tmp` file, `sync_all` fsync, atomic rename, and corrupted JSON backup recovery. | Validates filesystem persistence contract. |
| **Terminal & Preferences** (`tests/rorca_native_contract.rs`, `src/terminal/tests.rs`) | Ghostty config parsing, fallback defaults, 10 PTY unit tests covering natural exit reaping, explicit close reaping, dropped receiver cleanup, and signal forwarding. | macOS Option-as-Alt behavior is parsed correctly; live native key event delivery requires OS GUI execution. |
</answer>
